description: Common Paper PSA v1.1 (cover page + standard terms). Two signing tables (SOW cover, Key Terms cover): row labels in a left column, signature lines in PROVIDER/CUSTOMER columns, company names are placeholders.
traps: Row labels are in a separate left column, not next to the lines
Key Terms tables have many '[Fill in ...]' blanks that are not signature fields
Page-wide table rules must not become fields

description: Common Paper Cloud Service Agreement v1.0 cover page (4 pages, published PDF). Signature table on page 4 with PROVIDER/CUSTOMER columns.
traps: Checkbox glyphs for publicity rights are not signer fields
Grey placeholder text in the column headers

description: Bonterms Cloud Terms example cover page. 'Signature:', 'Name and Title:', 'Company:', 'Date:' labels in table cells with NO lines or underscores; Customer (left) and Provider (right) columns.
traps: No blank to sign on: the field must go in the empty space after the label
'Name and Title' is one combined field
Key Terms rows ('Effective Date', 'Fill in date') are not signer fields
